full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the filing of this petition, in brief, are that one Md. Moslemuddin instituted a suit being the Other Class Suit No.251 of 1978 in the Court of First Subordinate Judge, Mymensingh, on 02.08.1978, alleging therein that they acquired right, title and possession in the suit-land by taking pattan of the same from the Moharaja of Muktagacha with a further prayer for direction upon the concerned Tahsilder to record his name in the record of rights since he is in peaceful possession of the suit land but his name was not recorded. The learned Subordinate Judge, by his judgment and decree dated 26.11.1981, decreed the suit.
